business_problem: Start-up construction firm Industrialized Construction Group (ICG) needed technology to support its five-person team and business operations from day one but had limited resources.
solution_summary: Start-up construction firm Industrialized Construction Group (ICG) needed technology to support its five-person team and business operations from day one but had limited resources. ICG used Microsoft 365 to set up its entire operations, from budgeting in Excel to creating branded templates in Word and PowerPoint to managing emails in Outlook. Additionally, ICG used Power BI from day one to visualize data for its flagship product, Teams as a hybrid communication and file sharing hub with staff and customers, and Copilot to reduce writing time by more than half. “We want the suite of Microsoft products to not only grow with us, but to also anticipate our needs.” Find out more about ICG Build on LinkedIn “The use of Teams as a real-time communication hub within our tenant and across our clients’ tenants increases our speed of delivery by 50% and helps us to model the visibility and transparency the construction industry needs.” Melissa McEwen, Principal & Co-founder, ICG

ICG used Microsoft 365 to set up its entire operations, from budgeting in Excel to creating branded templates in Word and PowerPoint to managing emails in Outlook.

Additionally, ICG used Power BI from day one to visualize data for its flagship product, Teams as a hybrid communication and file sharing hub with staff and customers, and Copilot to reduce writing time by more than half.
The firm launched in early 2024 as an offshoot from an engineering firm.
And they needed it quickly, as ICG had clients in its first week of business and required invoicing, project management, and reporting tools.
The ICG team’s familiarity with Microsoft tools made Microsoft 365 for Business a smart choice.
“We chose Microsoft 365 so we could all be in the same environment and leverage learning,” says Masci.
From time of purchase, ICG had Microsoft 365 up and running in less than three hours.

Additionally, ICG used Power BI from day one to visualize data for its flagship product, Teams as a hybrid communication and file sharing hub with staff and customers, and Copilot to reduce writing time by more than half.
Since ICG brought along customers from its previous firm, the company used Teams Outlook , and OneDrive to transfer those customer files seamlessly.
It’s also how the company manages and shares insights from its Industrialized Construction Maturity industry database.

“As a startup that’s not ready to scale an enterprise accounting system or project management system, Microsoft products serve as a creative way to create a customer relationship management system,” says McEwen.
Growing the firm with Microsoft tools ICG is focused on scaling to meet its mission of leading the construction industry into a new era of excellence.
“Our work must scale to an audience and customer base that is 1,000 times larger than it is today,” says Masci.
